{{Quote|You will be reporting to the capitol to work for Gallura Handerin. She's a fairly high level government aide. She'll have some work for you.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WftG" />}}
'''Gallura Handerin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was high-ranking employee of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go see my cousin in the capitol building. Gallura can put you to good use. I'll send word to her to expect you as well as a glowing recommendation.|[[Pol Handerin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Farmer Pol Handerin|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Gallura Handerin worked in the [[Coronet Capitol|Capitol building]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] as a high level government aide.<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> She had a cousin who lived on the outskirts of Coronet, the farmer [[Pol Handerin]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Gallura Handerin recruited a spacer who previously worked with Pol Handerin to fulfill several missions. She first requested the spacer to check all the government drop boxes in Coronet City. She then asked the spacer to recover a [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] stolen from an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in the Capitol. She was very satisfied when the spacer brought back the armor even before the officer could notice the robbery. Eventually, Handerin tasked the spacer to find a missing government courier. However, the courier was assassinated by the criminal [[Preens B'oola]] in order to steal the government documents that the courier was carrying. B'oola asked for a huge ransom of 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] but the spacer killed him and recovered the documents. For all those services, Gallura Handerin then recommended the spacer to [[Brantlee Spondoon]], the aide to the [[Diktat]].<ref name="SWG:WftG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gallura Handerin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Gallura Handerin was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> She was part of the questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:WftG" />
